Form 1: True-to-Scale Vertical Timeline (Question: Over time / Follow) — maps 1969-2022 proportionally along the vertical feed paper.

Rejected Form 4: Exploded pie chart — rejected per Manual 13 dataviz rules.

Place: At a line printer, watching continuous fanfold paper feed through the tractor platen.

Tension Rule 1 (Dense vs Breathing): Dense middle timeline core (Y: 480–1520) with milestone cards and interval metrics; breathing upper marquee (Y: 60–440) and lower platen summary zone (Y: 1540–1860).
Tension Rule 2 (Three Sizes Minimum): Body type at 16–18px, Subheadings at 32–48px, Display Hero numerals at 144px (ratio > 8x body).
Tension Rule 3 (Boundary Crossing): Tractor-feed perforated margins bleed off left/right canvas edges; milestone cards break the timeline central axis; summary stats box crosses column partitions.
Tension Rule 4 (Non-uniform Ground): Continuous fanfold paper tone #F5F0E6 with greenbar/zebra accounting bands, perforation stitch lines, and platen mechanical markers.
Tension Rule 5 (Single Rotated System): Distinct neo-brutalist caution / status stamps rotated at -3.5° angle.
Timeline Extent: 1969–2022 (53 years). Gaps: 20y, 4y, 5y, 6y, 3y, 15y.

Stage 6: Constructing the complete high-fidelity Neo-Brutalist Fanfold Infographic poster.

Ground & Diegetic details: Continuous fanfold paper, tractor-feed sprocket tracks, greenbar zebra ledger stripes, fold perforation stitch lines, alignment registration crosses, mechanical feed tension guides, and brutalist verification stamps.

--- LITMUS TEST AUDIT RESULTS (Manual 13 §6) ---

Litmus Test 1 (Could this layout hold SaaS dashboard data?): NO. The diegetic fanfold tractor-feed ground, 1401 greenbar alternating ledger lines, continuous vertical time-mapped paper ribbon, sprocket margins, and brutalist physical stampings are intrinsically tied to continuous temporal printout and historical epoch milestones.

Litmus Test 2 (Cover text — is topic recognizable?): YES. The chronological vertical spine with milestone nodes, scale-proportional gap bracket spans, comparative duration bars, and the 53-year discrete calendar matrix clearly communicate milestone pacing and time intervals even without reading copy.

Litmus Test 3 (Are all 4 corners doing equal work?): NO. Top-left has form header / crosshair, Top-right has sequence & sync stamps, Bottom-left hosts the 53-year discrete proportional dot matrix, and Bottom-right anchors the rotated audit stamp. Visual gravity drives downward from the hero marquee along the vertical platen feed.

Litmus Test 4 (Zero-baseline & Area Proportions): VERIFIED. Gap duration bars have strict zero baseline (isZeroBased = true, domain 0 to 20). 53-year matrix encodes discrete calendar units (1:1 ink per year).
Figure reconciliation against brief.md:
- 1969: ARPANET first message (crashed after "LO") -> Present & verified.
- 1989: Tim Berners-Lee proposes World Wide Web -> Present & verified.
